apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Changed
- Look again and Get the missing songs show how it's going: while they work, a wheel turns and they say how many are still to go ("Getting them · 10 to go"). Pressed again, they stop: songs already downloading finish, the rest aren't looked for. Each song's dot shows at once.

Fixed
- Songs Soulseek had that Tuna passed over: - "Song - Original" (and "- Bonus Track") was looked for with "Original" in it; now as "Song". - What's in brackets in a file's name counts: "Love Is the Message (Live at Abbey Road Studios)" and "Baiana (Cosme Martin & Christian Vila Remix)" were taken for the plain songs and passed over. - "&" may be written "and", a comma or nothing: small words like these no longer have to match. - Long searches can come back empty: Tuna also searches the artist and the title's main part.
- A song not live or instrumental no longer takes a copy whose name says "(Live)" or "(Instrumental)" in brackets.

To update: the server (pull the new image). The apps need nothing new.
